justification: Structural plumbing for the Intelligence Brief (Slice 0 of the content-enrichment plan): S1 DataField fail-closed invariant, S2 typed service contracts for six services, S3 golden fixtures captured from the real services plus a field-coverage ratchet wired into pre-push. No user-visible change; verified by A/B live smoke on the four demo addresses.

pre_impl.existing_data: Prior PRs 593-600 already shipped the failsoft lint, unwrap helper, WO-1..5 fail-closed fixes and flood/bushfire/shadow contracts; this slice extends that system rather than duplicating it. lep_land_use_table columns (lga, zone, development_type, permissibility) confirmed by live read-only SELECT during fixture capture.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Two assumptions fell to real data: permissibility is not binary (real vocabulary includes exempt, caught by the golden fixture), and a blunt AUTHORITATIVE-plus-null coercion would flip the documented legitimately-empty state (zone with no height control), so the S1 validator is gated on the error reason field instead.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Contracts live beside the existing three in intelligence_brief.py (single contract home, same _warn_on_drift mechanism); the ratchet and capture scripts are new because no existing tool locks the brief output surface or persists real service emissions; development_permissions_db.py was checked and queries the older regulatory_provisions table, not lep_land_use_table.

functions.name: _fail_closed_on_errored_authoritative
functions.input: the constructed DataField instance after normal pydantic validation completes
functions.output: the same DataField, with confidence coerced to NOT_AVAILABLE when value is None and an error reason is present at AUTHORITATIVE
functions.if_none: value None with no reason is the documented legitimately-empty state and is deliberately left untouched so honest empty cards keep their badge

functions.name: collect_from_roots
functions.input: list of pydantic model classes to walk recursively including parametrised DataField generics
functions.output: mapping of model name to sorted field names for every reachable model; raises RuntimeError on a same-name collision with different fields
functions.if_none: an empty roots list yields an empty map which then fails the baseline comparison loudly rather than passing vacuously

functions.name: check
functions.input: current field map and the checked-in baseline field map loaded from JSON
functions.output: exit code 1 when any baseline model or field is missing from current code; renames count as losses
functions.if_none: a missing baseline file is reported as failure instructing regen, never silently treated as a pass

functions.name: _build_terrain_detail
functions.input: raw terrain service dict or None when the fetch failed or was not requested
functions.output: TerrainAnalysisDetail built from the terrain service's shared model with a drift warning logged when a contract key is missing
functions.if_none: returns None so the terrain card renders NOT_AVAILABLE with the real failure reason, distinct from a populated detail with null metrics

values.read_at: scripts/capture_brief_golden_fixtures.py capture_lep_land_use via live SELECT DISTINCT
values.if_missing: the golden-fixture test asserts permitted and prohibited exist in the vocabulary; if the DB renamed them the capture plus test fail visibly

queries.purpose: capture a real row spread and the permissibility vocabulary for the LEP land-use golden fixture
queries.where_clause: WHERE zone = %s (parameterised, read-only, ORDER BY permissibility LIMIT 60)

break_it.scenario: A failed upstream fetch's value and error reason are copied into a new DataField stamped AUTHORITATIVE by a future refactor
break_it.what_happens: Before this slice the card rendered a confident blank that reads as checked-and-empty; now the model validator coerces it to NOT_AVAILABLE at construction so the failure stays visible
break_it.how: S1 model_validator on DataField plus test_errored_fetch_at_authoritative_is_coerced_to_not_available and the all-failed assembly walk asserting zero authoritative-null fields

break_it.scenario: StrataHub enrichment returns lot_total as text junk so the count check is skipped and the weak lot-area heuristic classifies a 77-lot apartment parcel as DEVELOPMENT
break_it.what_happens: The brief would emit a DevelopmentBrief with capacity claims for a strata lot; the S2 tripwire now turns the type violation into the fail-closed AMBIGUOUS route with a NOT_AVAILABLE strata card
break_it.how: StrataServiceOutput validation in the SSE path routes contract violations to strata_failed; covered by test_strata_type_junk_routes_to_renovation_not_silent_development

break_it.scenario: The climate service reshapes hazards from a list to a dict keyed by hazard name
break_it.what_happens: Previously ClimateDisclosureProfile construction raised inside assembly and killed the stream; now the contract violation is logged and climate is counted as a failed source while UHI ARR FIRMS still report
break_it.how: ClimateRiskServiceOutput tripwire in _build_climate_disclosure; test asserts sources_queried drops from 4 to 3 versus the on-contract fixture

break_it.scenario: A refactor renames a field on a brief section model, deleting the old one, so a card quietly stops surfacing data it used to show
break_it.what_happens: The field-coverage ratchet compares 52 locked models against the baseline in pre-push and fails the push naming the exact model and field lost; a rename counts as a loss plus an addition, never a wash
break_it.how: scripts/brief_field_coverage_ratchet.py wired as pre-push step 1c plus test_rename_is_a_loss_not_a_wash
break_it.repro: python scripts/brief_field_coverage_ratchet.py after deleting any model field

break_it.scenario: The cadastre service renames is_strata; the tolerant contract parses it to the default False so validation alone cannot catch the rename
break_it.what_happens: Runtime logs a CONTRACT-DRIFT warning via the core-keys drift check, and the golden fixture plus check_drift test fail on re-capture, so the rename is caught by the S3 layer instead of shipping as silent not-strata
break_it.how: StrataCoreOutput drift check on real traffic plus test_strata_renamed_key_is_visible_drift_not_clean
